name: Flinders Financial Hardship Grant
summary: $500 second-half-of-year grant for domestic or international Flinders students with 36 units done who face financial hardship.
key: The value of the grant awarded will be $500.
who: Have successfully completed at least 36 units of study at Flinders University recently
Must show the grant will help you continue studying
how: Submit the online Student Support Grant form with supporting documents
catches: Available during the second half of the year
Applications received by the Semester 2 census date are assessed together; later ones monthly while funds last
